introduction: Two OCI images, built from one Containerfile at sandbox/images/Containerfile, carry the sandbox agent agentkit-sandboxd at sandbox.AgentPath. The base image is a Debian trixie-slim image that runs as is. The overlay image is a single-layer image that an embedder copies into its own toolchain image. This spec also adds the build-time version stamp in buildver, the image-reference helpers in package sandbox, the sandbox-images make targets, the opt-in end-to-end image tests, the offline consistency checks that run in make check, and the GHCR release workflow. That workflow publishes both images for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only after the tests pass, then verifies them with an anonymous pull.

glossary.CA bundle: The Debian CA certificate bundle at /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, installed by the ca-certificates package.
glossary.Landlock check: The probe run through proxy execute when Agent().Landlock.ABI is 2 or more: `touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe` must exit non-zero and `touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p` must exit 0.
glossary.base image: quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandbox, built by `--target base`. It is FROM debian:trixie-slim and holds the cgo-built agent, git, bash, ca-certificates and the uid-1000 user agentkit.
glossary.canonical release version: `v` followed by MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no leading zeros and an optional `-prerelease`. It carries no `+` build metadata and is not a pseudo-version.
glossary.consistency test: sandbox/images/consistency_test.go. It reads the Containerfile, the Makefile and the release workflow, needs no container engine, and runs in make check.
glossary.container engine: podman or docker. make chooses it with the CONTAINER variable; the image tests choose it with AGENTKIT_CONTAINER, falling back to podman and then docker on PATH.
glossary.derived image: An image built from a Containerfile of `FROM <image>` followed by the single line sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay ref>). In the tests the FROM image is the base image.
glossary.digest check: 13's Tools RPC comparison of the agent's tool-definition digests with the host's. It fails with sandbox.ErrToolMismatch on any difference.
glossary.expected version: The agent version the image tests require: the value of AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION, or `(devel)` when that variable is empty.
glossary.harness: The helper in the test-only package sandbox/images. It starts an agent container with `run --rm -i`, wraps the child's pipes with stdioconn.New and attaches with attach.Dial.
glossary.overlay image: quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandboxd, built by `--target overlay`. It is a FROM scratch image with one layer, holding only the statically linked agent at sandbox.AgentPath.
glossary.proxy tool: A core.Tool returned by Sandbox.Tools whose handler runs the named tool (execute, write_file) inside the sandbox.
glossary.pseudo-version: A Go module version whose prerelease ends, at its start or after a `.`, in a 14-digit timestamp, a `-` and 12 lowercase hex digits. The three forms are vX.0.0-yyyymmddhhmmss-abcdefabcdef, vX.Y.Z-0.yyyymmddhhmmss-abcdefabcdef and vX.Y.Z-pre.0.yyyymmddhhmmss-abcdefabcdef.
glossary.release workflow: .github/workflows/sandbox-images.yml. Its images job builds, tests and publishes; its verify job pulls anonymously and runs the published agents.
glossary.stamp: The unexported string variable buildver.stamp. It is set only at link time with `-ldflags -X` from the AGENTKIT_VERSION build argument.

requirements.title: One Containerfile with two targets and its build context
requirements.rationale: Both images share one module download and one source tree, and the build is the same on a developer's machine and on the release runner. If psx's cgo variant fails to link without CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW, the work stops and the failure is recorded in docs/errata/16_sandbox_images.md instead of being worked around (DD 19).

criteria.action: build the base image under `--target base` and the overlay image under `--target overlay`, with the repository root as the build context, where the overlay target copies only from the static build stage
criteria.contract: `<engine> build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target base .` and `--target overlay .`, each run from the repository root, exit 0 and produce one image each

criteria.action: run every build stage `FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.27-trixie` with `GOTOOLCHAIN=local` set, and copy go.mod and go.sum and run `go mod download` before copying the rest of the source
criteria.contract: a go directive in go.mod that is newer than the builder's toolchain fails the build instead of downloading a toolchain

criteria.action: compile ./sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd in the cgo stage with CGO_ENABLED=1, GOOS=linux and GOARCH=$TARGETARCH, and in the static stage with CGO_ENABLED=0, both with `-trimpath`, `-buildvcs=false` and `-ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=${AGENTKIT_VERSION}"`
criteria.contract: the cgo-built agent reports OutlineBackend "tree-sitter"; the static agent runs in an image that holds no libc

criteria.condition: TARGETARCH differs from BUILDARCH
criteria.action: install Debian's crossbuild-essential-$TARGETARCH in the cgo stage and set CC to x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc for amd64 or aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc for arm64
criteria.contract: a linux/arm64 build on an amd64 builder, and the reverse, compiles the cgo agent on the build platform without emulating the target

criteria.condition: TARGETARCH is neither amd64 nor arm64
criteria.action: fail the build before compiling the agent
criteria.contract: the build exits non-zero with a message naming linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 as the two supported platforms

criteria.action: declare the build arguments AGENTKIT_VERSION and AGENTKIT_REVISION, both defaulting to empty, and set neither CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW nor any environment variable other than GOTOOLCHAIN, CGO_ENABLED, GOOS, GOARCH and CC
criteria.contract: the Containerfile text contains no CGO_LDFLAGS_ALLOW; a build with no build arguments stamps nothing

criteria.action: exclude .git, .github, .specs, .claude, build, codesearch, docs, coverage.*, *.test and .DS_Store from the build context, and exclude neither go.mod, go.sum nor any directory that holds a root-module package
criteria.contract: for every package that `go list ./...` reports in the root module, no .dockerignore pattern matches its directory, and every listed exclusion is present

requirements.title: The base image
requirements.rationale: The base image is the default sandbox: a small Debian image with exactly git, bash and ca-certificates, a numeric non-root user, and a root-owned agent laid out to match 15's Landlock roots.

criteria.action: be built FROM debian:trixie-slim with git, bash and ca-certificates installed with --no-install-recommends and the apt lists removed afterwards, and contain no rsync, curl or tini
criteria.contract: inside the container, `git --version` and `test -s` of the CA bundle exit 0, while `command -v rsync` and `command -v curl` exit non-zero

criteria.action: define user agentkit with uid 1000, group agentkit with gid 1000, home /home/agentkit owned 1000:1000 and login shell /bin/bash, and declare `USER 1000:1000` in numeric form
criteria.contract: `id -u` and `id -g` run through proxy execute each print 1000; `image inspect` reports Config.User "1000:1000"

criteria.action: create /workspace owned 1000:1000 with mode 0755, set `WORKDIR /workspace`, and declare no VOLUME
criteria.contract: `stat -c %u /workspace /home/agentkit` prints 1000 twice; Config.Volumes is empty; Agent().Workdir is "/workspace"; a proxy write_file of probe.txt succeeds

criteria.action: set `safe.directory = *` in the system git config
criteria.contract: `git config --system --get-all safe.directory` prints `*`

criteria.action: hold the cgo-built agent at sandbox.AgentPath, owned 0:0 with mode 0755, and set `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd"]`
criteria.contract: `stat -c '%u %a'` of the agent prints `0 755`; Config.Entrypoint is [sandbox.AgentPath]; Agent().OutlineBackend is "tree-sitter" and Agent().Git is true

criteria.action: declare no ENV beyond what debian:trixie-slim already sets
criteria.contract: the variable names in Config.Env are a subset of {PATH}

criteria.action: carry the labels org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go, org.opencontainers.image.licenses=Apache-2.0, org.opencontainers.image.title, org.opencontainers.image.description, org.opencontainers.image.version from AGENTKIT_VERSION and org.opencontainers.image.revision from AGENTKIT_REVISION
criteria.contract: Config.Labels carries exactly the source and licenses values above, and non-empty title and description values

criteria.condition: an agent started from the base image reports Agent().Landlock.ABI of 2 or more
criteria.action: place /home/agentkit, /tmp and /workspace under 15's writable roots and every other path the tools use under its read-only system directories, so that the Landlock check passes
criteria.contract: through proxy execute, `touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe` exits non-zero and `touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p` exits 0

requirements.title: The overlay image and derived images
requirements.rationale: An embedder who needs a toolchain adds the agent to its own image with one COPY line, so the overlay must be a single static file and that exact line must work.

criteria.action: be built FROM scratch with a single COPY of the static agent to sandbox.AgentPath, so that the image has exactly one layer, holding the agent owned 0:0 with mode 0755
criteria.contract: `image inspect` reports exactly one entry in RootFS.Layers

criteria.action: set `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd"]` and carry the same OCI labels as the base image
criteria.contract: Config.Entrypoint is [sandbox.AgentPath]; `run --rm --entrypoint <AgentPath> <overlay> --version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd <expected version> (protocol M.N)`, which proves the binary runs with no libc

criteria.condition: an image is built from a context whose Containerfile is `FROM <base image>` followed by the single line sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay ref>)
criteria.action: run the copied static agent when the harness starts it
criteria.contract: Agent().OutlineBackend is "none", Agent().Version is the expected version, Tools(ctx, ToolOptions{}) passes the digest check, and proxy execute of `echo ok` exits 0

criteria.condition: an agent started from the derived image reports Agent().Landlock.ABI of 2 or more
criteria.action: pass the same Landlock check as the base image
criteria.contract: through proxy execute, `touch /var/tmp/agentkit-probe` exits non-zero and `touch "$HOME/p" /tmp/p /workspace/p` exits 0

requirements.title: The build-time version stamp
requirements.rationale: An explicit build argument stamps the same version locally and in CI, without .git in the context or a tag-aware checkout (DD 4).

criteria.action: declare an unexported package variable `stamp string` with no initializer, set only through `-ldflags -X`, and leave the package's exported API unchanged
criteria.contract: `go doc -all ./sandbox/internal/buildver` lists the same exported identifiers as before this spec

criteria.condition: stamp is non-empty
criteria.action: return stamp from Version()
criteria.contract: with stamp set to "v0.6.0", Version() returns "v0.6.0"

criteria.condition: stamp is empty
criteria.action: return from Version() exactly what 13 specified: the agentkit-go module version from runtime/debug build info, or `(devel)` when that is absent or empty
criteria.contract: after the in-package test clears stamp, Version() returns the build-info value; a host binary that never sets the stamp reports the same version as before this spec

criteria.condition: agentkit-sandboxd is built with `-ldflags "-X github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=v9.8.7"` and run with --version
criteria.action: print the stamped version
criteria.contract: stdout is `agentkit-sandboxd v9.8.7 (protocol <ProtocolMajor>.<ProtocolMinor>)`, formatted from sandbox.ProtocolMajor and sandbox.ProtocolMinor, and the exit code is 0; the command test that builds it into a temp dir skips under -short

criteria.condition: an image is built with AGENTKIT_VERSION empty
criteria.action: produce an agent that reports `(devel)`, because the context carries no .git and the build uses -buildvcs=false
criteria.contract: Agent().Version is "(devel)" and `--version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd (devel) (protocol M.N)`

criteria.condition: an image is built with AGENTKIT_VERSION set to a version such as v0.6.0
criteria.action: produce an agent that reports that version in Hello and in --version
criteria.contract: Agent().Version is "v0.6.0" and `--version` prints `agentkit-sandboxd v0.6.0 (protocol M.N)`

requirements.title: Image references in package sandbox
requirements.rationale: The publishing pipeline and the code that names the images must agree, and a build with no published image must get an explicit error, not a nearby release that might fail the digest check.

criteria.action: export from sandbox/image.go the constants BaseImageRepo = "quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandbox" and OverlayImageRepo = "quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandboxd", and the variable ErrNoPublishedImage = errors.New("sandbox: no published image for this agentkit-go version")

criteria.condition: ImageTag receives a canonical release version
criteria.action: return the version without its leading `v`
criteria.contract: ImageTag("v0.6.0") returns ("0.6.0", true) and ImageTag("v1.2.3-rc.1") returns ("1.2.3-rc.1", true)

criteria.condition: the version passed to ImageTag is empty, is `(devel)`, carries `+` build metadata (including +dirty and +incompatible), lacks the leading `v`, has a leading zero in a numeric part, or is otherwise not canonical
criteria.action: refuse the version
criteria.contract: ImageTag returns ("", false)

criteria.condition: the version passed to ImageTag is a pseudo-version in any of its three forms
criteria.action: refuse the version
criteria.contract: ImageTag returns ("", false) for v0.0.0-20240102150405-abcdefabcdef, v1.2.4-0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef and v1.2.3-pre.0.20240102150405-abcdefabcdef

criteria.condition: ImageTag accepts the version that buildver.Version() reports
criteria.action: return BaseImageRepo + ":" + tag from DefaultImage and OverlayImageRepo + ":" + tag from OverlayImage, both thin wrappers over one unexported function that takes the version as a parameter
criteria.contract: for version v1.2.3 the unexported builder yields ("quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandbox:1.2.3", nil) and ("quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandboxd:1.2.3", nil)

criteria.condition: ImageTag refuses the build's version
criteria.action: return an empty reference and an error from DefaultImage and OverlayImage
criteria.contract: errors.Is(err, ErrNoPublishedImage) is true, and the message names the version, Spec.Image and `make sandbox-images`

criteria.action: return "COPY --from=" + ref + " " + AgentPath + " " + path.Dir(AgentPath) + "/" from OverlayCopyLine(ref)
criteria.contract: OverlayCopyLine("x:1") returns `COPY --from=x:1 /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd /usr/local/libexec/`

criteria.action: for any string v for which ImageTag(v) returns ok, guarantee that "v" + tag equals v, that v contains no `+`, and that v is not a pseudo-version

requirements.title: Make targets
requirements.rationale: One make target builds both images for the host platform with podman or docker, and a second runs the end-to-end tests against them, outside make check.

criteria.action: define these variables, each overridable on the make command line: CONTAINER (podman when on PATH, else docker); SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE (quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandbox); SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE (quay.io/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-sandboxd); SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG (dev); SANDBOX_PLATFORM (empty); AGENTKIT_VERSION (empty); AGENTKIT_REVISION (`git rev-parse HEAD`, or empty outside a checkout)

criteria.condition: `make sandbox-images` runs
criteria.action: run `$(CONTAINER) build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target base` and then the same command with `--target overlay`, from the repository root. Each passes `--build-arg AGENTKIT_VERSION` and `--build-arg AGENTKIT_REVISION`; the two builds tag $(SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE):$(SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG) and $(SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE):$(SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG) respectively; `--platform $(SANDBOX_PLATFORM)` is passed only when SANDBOX_PLATFORM is non-empty
criteria.contract: `make -n sandbox-images` prints the base build before the overlay build, with exactly those arguments

criteria.condition: CONTAINER names no command on PATH, which with the default means neither podman nor docker is installed
criteria.action: fail `make sandbox-images` before running any build
criteria.contract: make exits non-zero with a message naming podman, docker and the CONTAINER variable, and no build command runs

criteria.condition: `make sandbox-images-test` runs
criteria.action: build both images through its sandbox-images prerequisite, then run `go test -count=1 -v ./sandbox/images/` with AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE set to the two tagged references, AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION set to AGENTKIT_VERSION, and AGENTKIT_CONTAINER set to CONTAINER
criteria.contract: make exits with go test's status

criteria.action: give sandbox-images and sandbox-images-test each a `## ` help comment, and keep both out of the prerequisites of check
criteria.contract: `make help` lists both targets; `make -n check` prints no container engine command

requirements.title: End-to-end image tests
requirements.rationale: The images are checked over the real agent protocol before release. The tests are skipped, not failed, where no engine or image is available (PRD 11).

criteria.condition: go test runs with -short, no container engine is found, or the image variable a test needs is unset
criteria.action: skip the test instead of failing it
criteria.contract: the test reports SKIP with a message naming `make sandbox-images-test`, and go test exits 0

criteria.action: use the container engine named by AGENTKIT_CONTAINER, or, when it is unset, the first of podman and docker found on PATH

criteria.condition: the harness starts an agent from an image
criteria.action: run `$CONTAINER run --rm -i --name agentkit-imgtest-<random hex> --network none --env HOME=/home/agentkit --env TMPDIR=/tmp --entrypoint <sandbox.AgentPath> <image> <sandbox.AgentArgs(spec)…>` with spec {Network: NetworkNone, TTL: 10m, Workdir: "/workspace"}. Then wrap the child's pipes with stdioconn.New and attach with attach.Dial, whose Destroy kills the child and runs `$CONTAINER rm -f <name>`
criteria.contract: attach.Dial returns a live sandbox.Sandbox

criteria.condition: the harness has attached to an agent started from the base image or a derived image
criteria.action: require Agent().Version to equal the expected version, Agent().ProtocolMajor to equal sandbox.ProtocolMajor, and Tools(ctx, ToolOptions{}) to pass the digest check
criteria.contract: Tools returns a nil error and a non-empty tool list; an ErrToolMismatch or a version difference fails the test with both values in the message

criteria.condition: the container fails to start, attach.Dial fails, or an assertion fails
criteria.action: fail the test, report the engine's stderr, and still run cleanup
criteria.contract: the test fails with the engine's stderr in its output, and no container named agentkit-imgtest-<hex> from that test remains

criteria.action: close the sandbox, remove the container and remove every image the test built during cleanup, whether the test passes or fails
criteria.contract: after each test, `$CONTAINER ps -a` lists no container named agentkit-imgtest-* from that test, and the derived image reference is absent from `$CONTAINER images`

criteria.condition: the attached agent reports Agent().Landlock.ABI below 2
criteria.action: log Agent().Landlock.Note and skip only the Landlock check
criteria.contract: the test does not run the /var/tmp probe, and its outcome depends only on the other assertions

requirements.title: Offline checks in make check
requirements.rationale: make check must stay offline and engine-free (Goal 6), while one constant pair and a file-reading test keep the Containerfile, the Makefile and the workflow from drifting apart.

criteria.action: assert that the Containerfile has stages named base and overlay, that the overlay stage starts FROM scratch, that both stages name sandbox.AgentPath as the agent's COPY destination and in ENTRYPOINT, and that it carries `-X <module>/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=`, with <module> read from go.mod

assert that the Makefile's default SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE and SANDBOX_OVERLAY_IMAGE equal sandbox.BaseImageRepo and sandbox.OverlayImageRepo, and that the release workflow names both repositories and sandbox/images/Containerfile

criteria.condition: the Containerfile, the Makefile or the release workflow differs from the constants or the stage layout the consistency test asserts
criteria.action: fail without needing a container engine
criteria.contract: the test fails with a message naming the file and the expected value

criteria.action: run the buildver, image-reference and consistency tests while building no image and invoking no container engine
criteria.contract: make check exits 0 on a host with neither podman nor docker on PATH, and TS-09-20 passes

criteria.action: hold only _test.go files, so that internal/policy's cross-target gate (cgo off, four targets) and host-cgo gate build and vet it
criteria.contract: TestCrossTargetBuildAndVet and TestHostCgoBuildAndVet pass

criteria.action: add no require directive to any go.mod, leave the exported API of the packages agentkit, core, tools and codemode unchanged, and stay within TS-12-14's line budgets
criteria.contract: the direct-dependency allowlist test and TS-12-14 pass

requirements.title: The release workflow's images job
requirements.rationale: A tag push publishes both multi-arch images only after the image tests pass on the runner, and a dispatch run is a dry run that never pushes.

criteria.action: trigger on push of tags matching `v*` and on workflow_dispatch; declare top-level `permissions: contents: read`, with only the publishing job adding `packages: write`; and group concurrency per ref with `cancel-in-progress: false`
fail before building or publishing
criteria.contract: the version step exits non-zero with a message naming the ref, and no image is pushed

criteria.action: for any ref name that matches the version pattern, set the version to the ref name and the image tags to the version without its `v`, plus MAJOR.MINOR when the version has no prerelease part
criteria.contract: v1.2.3 yields the tags 1.2.3 and 1.2; v1.2.3-rc.1 yields only 1.2.3-rc.1

criteria.condition: the images job runs on ubuntu-24.04
criteria.action: check out the repository, set up Go with `go-version-file: go.mod`, and run `make sandbox-images-test CONTAINER=docker SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG=ci AGENTKIT_VERSION=<version> AGENTKIT_REVISION=$GITHUB_SHA`. This runs with the runner's default docker builder, before any QEMU or buildx setup step
criteria.contract: the test step appears before every setup-qemu, setup-buildx, login and push step in the job

criteria.condition: the test step fails
criteria.action: end the job without publishing
criteria.contract: the job fails, and no login or push step runs

criteria.condition: the run was triggered by a tag push
criteria.action: set up QEMU and buildx, log in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, and run `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --push` once with `--target base` and once with `--target overlay`. Both builds take the same build arguments and every computed tag on their own repository
criteria.contract: both repositories carry each computed tag as a manifest list for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64

criteria.condition: the run was triggered by workflow_dispatch
criteria.action: build and test with an empty version, compute no publishing tags, never log in, never push, and skip the verify job
criteria.contract: every login and push step and the verify job are conditioned on a tag push

criteria.action: use only actions/checkout, actions/setup-go, docker/setup-qemu-action, docker/setup-buildx-action and docker/login-action, each pinned to a major version tag, and compute tags in shell rather than with a third-party action
criteria.contract: every `uses:` line names one of those five actions followed by `@v<major>`

requirements.title: The release workflow's verify job
requirements.rationale: A package that only maintainers can pull has not been published for embedders, so each release is proven by an anonymous pull on every platform (DD 17).

criteria.condition: the run was triggered by a tag push
criteria.action: set up QEMU without logging in to any registry and, for each repository, computed tag and platform in {linux/amd64, linux/arm64}, run `docker pull --platform <platform> <reference>`
criteria.contract: the job declares `needs: images`, has no login step, and pulls every repository, tag and platform combination

criteria.condition: the verify job has pulled a reference
criteria.action: run it with `--entrypoint /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd` and the argument `--version`
criteria.contract: the output starts with `agentkit-sandboxd <version> ` for every repository, tag and platform

criteria.condition: an anonymous pull fails, as it does while a GHCR package is still private, or the --version output lacks the expected prefix
criteria.action: fail without touching the images already published
criteria.contract: the job exits non-zero naming the reference, and it can be re-run alone without re-running the images job

execution_paths.title: A developer builds the images and tests the base image locally

steps.action: runs `make sandbox-images-test AGENTKIT_VERSION=v0.6.0` on a Linux or macOS host with podman or docker
resolves CONTAINER and runs `build -f sandbox/images/Containerfile --target base` and then `--target overlay`, passing AGENTKIT_VERSION and AGENTKIT_REVISION and tagging both :dev references
download modules, compile agentkit-sandboxd with cgo and statically with `-X …buildver.stamp=v0.6.0`, and assemble the base and overlay images
runs `go test -count=1 -v ./sandbox/images/` with the AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_* variables and AGENTKIT_CONTAINER set
runs `run --rm -i --network none --entrypoint <AgentPath> <base> <AgentArgs(spec)…>`, wraps the pipes with stdioconn.New and attaches with attach.Dial
applies its Landlock ruleset and answers Hello with Version v0.6.0, Workdir /workspace, OutlineBackend tree-sitter and Git true
call Tools, which passes the digest check, and run proxy execute and write_file probes as uid 1000 inside /workspace
closes the sandbox and removes the container; go test reports PASS and make exits 0

execution_paths.title: An embedder adds the agent to its own image with the overlay COPY line

steps.action: calls sandbox.OverlayCopyLine(<overlay ref>) and writes a Containerfile of `FROM <base ref>` followed by that line into a temporary context
builds the derived image, copying the static agent from the overlay image to /usr/local/libexec/agentkit-sandboxd
starts the derived image with `--entrypoint <AgentPath>` and sandbox.AgentArgs(spec), and attaches with attach.Dial
answers Hello with OutlineBackend none and the expected version
call Tools, which passes the digest check, and run proxy execute of `echo ok`, which exits 0
closes the sandbox and removes the container and the derived image

execution_paths.title: A maintainer publishes a release by pushing a version tag

steps.action: pushes the git tag vX.Y.Z to github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go
validates GITHUB_REF_NAME against the version pattern and computes the tags X.Y.Z and X.Y
runs `make sandbox-images-test CONTAINER=docker SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG=ci AGENTKIT_VERSION=vX.Y.Z AGENTKIT_REVISION=$GITHUB_SHA` on the default docker builder, and the tests pass
sets up QEMU and buildx, logs in to ghcr.io with GITHUB_TOKEN, and pushes both targets for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 with every computed tag
pulls each repository, tag and platform anonymously and runs `--version`, which prints `agentkit-sandboxd vX.Y.Z (protocol M.N)`

execution_paths.title: An embedder's binary resolves the default image for its agentkit-go version

steps.action: built against agentkit-go at a release version, or stamped with `-X …buildver.stamp=vX.Y.Z`, calls sandbox.DefaultImage() and sandbox.OverlayImage()
